thread:
Maria G: Quick heads-up — Wavelength (hw partner) wants a joint marketplace listing + co-announcement for next Wed. They asked for press timing, landing hero, SI callouts, and a partner quote. Can we do a quick readiness check?

Jordan (PR): Do we have an embargo window from them? need to sync on press pickup times. :eyes:

Maria G: They want embargo 08:00 PST Wed. Also asked for a co-branded hero and a 50–75 word partner blurb.

Amy R: I can draft hero copy & CTA. who owns the partner blurb?

Sahil P: I can own the SI/integration callout. Need to confirm which SI features to highlight (KV caching, autoscaling hints, private deploy options). Also need SI contact from Wavelength for co-authored docs.

Evan T: We need the tile assets for the marketplace (banner 1200x600, logo SVG, short description). Can we get their brand kit?

Maria G: I asked for brand kit in the email thread — they said they'll send an asset pack by EOD today.

Jordan (PR): Great. For press: I need a one-paragraph exec quote (from Ana or Jordan?), a datapoint about latency improvements, and a customer / SI testimonial if we have one. Can marketing produce a short factoid?

Amy R: Marketing can pull a latency datapoint (typical gen p95 on dedicated configs). I'll grab that with @Evan T.

Evan T: I can surface the p95 numbers and a short graph export. Will attach to the doc.

Sahil P: For SI bits: proposed callout text (short): "Supported integration with Wavelength's edge accelerator for sub-50ms token latency on short-form inference; validated KV cache compatibility and private VPC install flows." Want to circulate?

Maria G: That reads good. Jordan — does that work for press/landing?

Jordan (PR): Yes but shorten to one line for hero. Keep the longer blurb on the partner details section. Also need approval from legal for co-branded assets and the quote — pinging them now.

DeployBot: NOTE: marketplace staging slot reserved for Redwood at 2026-04-14T02:00Z. Cutover runbook draft created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-wavelength

Amy R: Quick draft checklist (putting here so we can iterate):
```
- Hero copy + CTA (Amy)
- Partner 50–75w blurb (Wavelength -> Maria to collect)
- Exec quote (PR)
- Assets: logo svg, 1200x600 banner, 600x600 tile (Wavelength)
- SI callout + tech bullet (Sahil)
- Listing metadata (Evan)
- Staging cutover tested (DevOps/DeployBot)
- Legal approval on co-brand + embargo (Legal)
```

Sahil P: Adding technical contact: will ask Wavelength for SI lead email. Also: can we add a small "integration guide" link on the landing? a short markdown doc.

Maria G: Yes please. We'll link to /docs/partners/wavelength-integration. Evan — can you create the doc skeleton?

Evan T: On it. Skeleton created: https://redwood.internal/docs/wavelength-integration (placeholder)

Jordan (PR): Proposed timeline: Mon internal final review, Tue legal sign-off & asset drop, Wed 08:00 PST embargo publish. Is that feasible?

Amy R: We're tight but doable if assets land today/tomorrow. I'll have hero drafts by EOD tomorrow.

Sahil P: I'll have SI callout + guide skeleton populated by tomorrow noon.

Maria G: Legal pinged. Ana (legal) replied: "Will review co-brand assets + quote by Tue 1700 PST."

Jordan (PR): Good. I'll prep the press wire and co-announce email. Need final exec quote by Tue 1500 PST.

Evan T: Uploading assets and numbers as they come; will update the runbook link.

Maria G: Assigning owners: Amy (hero + CTA), Evan (assets & listing metadata), Sahil (SI callout + guide), Jordan (press & quote coordination), Maria (partner liaison & embargo). Please react with :thumbsup: when you have acknowledged.

Amy R: :thumbsup:

Sahil P: :thumbsup:

Evan T: :thumbsup:

Jordan (PR): :thumbsup:

DeployBot: REMINDER: dry-run window in staging tomorrow 2026-04-13T16:00Z — runbook steps 1-5 must be green.

Maria G: Thanks all — I'll post a short status update in this thread after the asset pack drops.

WavelengthPartner (via email): Assets attached: logo.zip + hero-1200.png. Sending SI lead: rachel@wavelength.com.

Maria G: Received assets and SI contact. uploading now.

Evan T: Received. prepping tile + verifying svg.

Jordan (PR): Can someone drop a 1-sentence partner blurb draft here for my press wire?

Amy R: "Wavelength and Redwood Inference are partnering to deliver low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference at the network edge, enabling customers to run private, high-performance AI workloads closer to end users."

Jordan (PR): Love it — I'll trim to press tone and slot into the wire.

Maria G: Closing loop: assets in runbook, SI lead connected, legal on track. Will update again Tue morning.

Evan T: all set on my end for asset prep.

Sahil P: will post integration doc link once I have content.

Jordan (PR): Final ask: share any embargo exceptions ASAP. Otherwise targeting Wed 08:00 PST.

Maria G: No exceptions noted by partner. Marking this thread as primary source for coordination.

Amy R: ack, thanks everyone.
